section_openings.Project Context: This section explains the background and learning concerns that guide the development of Land Grand. It begins with educational technology worldwide, then discusses home learning in the Philippines and the needs reported at Baluan Elementary School.
section_openings.Purpose and Description of the Project: This section explains the purpose of Land Grand and describes its main learning activities. It shows how the proposed game would support Grade 5 learners alongside printed learning materials.
section_openings.Objectives of the Project: This section presents the general and specific objectives of Land Grand. The four specific objectives follow the same order as the reported problems and describe features that can be built and checked.
section_openings.Scope and Limitations of the Project: This section describes the coverage and boundaries of the Land Grand project. It explains what the game includes and the limits of its use and the survey findings.
section_openings.Scope: This section outlines the learners, content, game activities, and technical requirements included in Land Grand. Project completion is planned for November–December 2026.
section_openings.Limitations: This section explains the limits of the game and how the survey findings should be understood. It identifies the boundaries of the project's learners, content, and offline use.

problems: Some surveyed parents of Grade 5 learners reported difficulty explaining lessons in printed modules to their children.
Some surveyed Grade 5 teachers did not consider modular learning effective in helping learners understand lessons.
Some parents of Grade 5 learners reported landforms as a difficult Science topic for their children.
Some Grade 5 parent and teacher responses identified rocks or minerals as difficult Science topics.
objectives: Provide a short Science lesson before each level to give Grade 5 learners additional explanations during home study.
Implement interactive exploration with movement and jumping controls and a review after each level to supplement printed Science learning materials.
Develop four episodes covering Mountains, Hills, Plains, and Plateaus, with lessons and exploration activities focused on these landforms.
Implement rock and mineral collection, with a pop-up showing each collected item's name and short description.
